changes.title: Enable hardware acceleration for Fire tablet CI
changes.detail: The Google-free Android 30 emulator now receives KVM permissions before launch, matching the functioning Android 26 emulator rather than relying on unstable unaccelerated software emulation.

changes.title: Detect and recover from interrupted Android package services
changes.detail: The Fire compatibility smoke keeps bounded install retries but now recognizes a disappearing package service as an emulator fault and requires PackageManager to recover before retrying.

changes.title: Check tablet acceleration and crash-test safeguards
changes.detail: Updated the report-only emulator contract assertions to verify KVM access, interrupted PackageManager handling, and strict failure when crash and installation checks cannot finish.
